thesis: Roku's near-52-week-high signal appears largely mechanical around the pending Fox merger rather than a clean standalone entry catalyst. The strongest counter-evidence is Roku's issuer-reported Q2 2026 revenue growth of 22%, including 25% platform growth, and positive net income; that operating strength does not remove the pending DOJ second-request review, shareholder and other approval risk, or the transaction-driven character of today's signal, so avoid initiating a new position.
invalidation: Reassess if the transaction clears its required reviews and approvals and a fresh, independently sourced operating catalyst supports an entry on standalone fundamentals.
sources: Roku Q2 2026 shareholder letter filed with the SEC: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1428439/000162828026054321/a04fy2026q2exhibit991.htm
Roku/Fox merger update filed with the SEC: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1428439/000114036126035993/ef20081770_425.htm

thesis: Docusign's issuer-reported Q2 fiscal 2027 results confirm a company-specific operating catalyst: revenue rose 9%, IAM reached 15.1% of ARR, and management raised full-year revenue, ARR-growth, and IAM-mix expectations. The strongest counter-evidence is that 1.3 percentage points of reported growth came from currency and total growth remains moderate; that does not change the read because IAM's share of ARR increased from 12.6% a year earlier while the company also reported positive GAAP diluted EPS and stronger operating cash flow. The resolved litigation disclosed in the latest filing does not create a near-term binary.
invalidation: Invalidate if IAM's share of ARR or overall ARR growth stalls materially, management cuts the fiscal-year outlook, or operating cash conversion weakens enough to undermine the confirmed margin progress.

thesis: UiPath's issuer-reported Q2 fiscal 2027 results confirm a company-specific improvement: revenue rose 13%, ARR rose 12% to $1.938 billion, and U.S. GAAP operating income was positive. The strongest counter-evidence is 109% dollar-based net retention and only $37 million of sequential net-new ARR, which indicate expansion is not yet rapid; that does not overturn the read because the company paired sustained ARR growth with positive GAAP operating income and a defined full-year revenue and ARR outlook. The disclosed legal matters have no identified scheduled ruling or deadline in the next 90 days.
invalidation: Invalidate if dollar-based net retention falls below 105%, ARR growth drops below 8%, management cuts its full-year outlook, or U.S. GAAP operating results return to a material loss.
sources: UiPath leadership update filed with the SEC: https://ir.uipath.com/financials/sec-filings/content/0001734722-26-000047/path-2026903xex992.htm

thesis: Baldwin's price, volume, and near-high signals are largely mechanical around its signed $32.50-per-share cash take-private agreement. The strongest positive counter-evidence is the definitive agreement's unanimous board approval and absence of a financing condition; that does not justify a new entry because the roughly 1.3% gross spread from the fresh quote is narrow relative to shareholder, regulatory, timing, and deal-break risk through the expected first-quarter 2027 close.
invalidation: Reassess only if the spread widens enough to compensate for documented closing risk or the required approvals are completed without a deterioration in deal terms.
sources: The Baldwin Group definitive merger announcement: https://ir.baldwin.com/news-releases/news-release-details/baldwin-group-go-private-through-majority-investment-sequence/

thesis: Knight-Swift's volume spike is a sector-wide reaction to a peer's warning and higher diesel costs, so it is sentiment-driven rather than a confirmed company-specific catalyst. The strongest counter-evidence is Knight-Swift's prior view that tightening capacity and bid improvements could support pricing; that does not resolve today's setup because the company has also documented sensitivity to fuel costs and no fresh Knight-Swift disclosure confirms that the peer and fuel pressures are already offset.
invalidation: Reassess after a company-specific update demonstrates improving pricing, fuel recovery, and segment margins rather than a move driven by peer commentary.
sources: Sector report on trucking weakness and diesel costs: https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-knightswift-transportation-stock-sliding-today-93CH-4871799

Knight-Swift updated guidance and fuel-cost discussion: https://investor.knight-swift.com/news/news-details/2026/Knight-Swift-Transportation-Holdings-Inc--Announces-Updated-First-Quarter-Earnings-Guidance-and-Introduces-Second-Quarter-Guidance/default.aspx

thesis: Asana's issuer-reported Q2 fiscal 2027 evidence is mixed: revenue grew 10%, management raised full-year revenue and adjusted/non-GAAP margin guidance, and AI-product rollout broadened, but dollar-based net retention remained below 100% and the company still reported a U.S. GAAP operating loss. The positive guidance does not resolve the sub-100% retention and GAAP-loss counter-evidence, so the 60-day price move lacks a sufficiently clear fundamental variant for a new entry.
invalidation: Reassess if dollar-based net retention returns above 100% alongside sustained U.S. GAAP operating improvement and disclosed evidence that AI adoption is producing durable expansion.
sources: Asana principal accounting officer update filed with the SEC: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1477720/000162828026059413/asan-20260826.htm

thesis: BOXX remains consistent with a reserve-like holding: the fund seeks returns through a one-to-three-month box-spread strategy, and the near-52-week-high signal is mechanical for that design rather than evidence of equity-like upside. The strongest counter-evidence is the prospectus-disclosed risk that box-spread pricing, derivatives, taxes, or market disruption can cause losses or tracking differences; that does not currently overturn the holding case because the fresh quote remains aligned with the fund's steadily rising recent NAV pattern, though no cost or lot basis is assumed.
invalidation: Exit or reassess if NAV and market price materially dislocate, the strategy produces an unexpected taxable distribution, or disclosed derivatives, liquidity, or tracking problems undermine its reserve role.
sources: Alpha Architect 1-3 Month Box ETF fund page: https://funds.alphaarchitect.com/boxetf/
BOXX statutory prospectus filed with the SEC: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1592900/000159290026000392/alphaarchitect1-3monthboxe.htm
